premises.text: B2B companies experience high traffic bounce rates that can be reduced through website personalization
premises.evidence_span: convert the 99% of their traffic that bounces today

premises.text: Personalization based on visitor industry increases lead generation
premises.evidence_span: the result of this personalization is a 54% increase in leads

premises.text: Technical expertise is required to effectively personalize websites
premises.evidence_span: the average marketing team does not have access to these technical expertise

premises.text: Mutiny provides a solution that integrates data analysis and website personalization
premises.evidence_span: Mutiny identifies the visitors to a website via pre-built data integration

premises.text: Built-in analytics allow companies to measure the impact of personalization
premises.evidence_span: it has built-in analytics to measure the results so the company can keep iterating

premises.text: Personalization can significantly increase conversion rates for specific audience segments
premises.evidence_span: this particular personalization has increased our conversion by 129%

value.text: B2B companies can convert more traffic into leads through personalized website experiences
value.evidence_span: 200% increase in outbound leads for BRACs, 40% site-wide increase in leads for Amplitude

notes: No traction metrics or external comparisons included.
